symbols.name: source transform length
symbols.meaning: The number of values in one source Fourier transform, which is the count being resampled.
symbols.quote: Here $q$ is the number of values in one source transform.

relations.quote: Gaussian resampling is the step that makes the transforms of the multiplier usable: it expresses each source [Discrete Fourier transform](discrete-fourier-transform.md) through a power-of-two tensor transform, meaning a transform over several axes at once in which each axis length is a power of two.

Gaussian resampling is applied to the [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) of the two integers' digit coefficients, so the Fourier transforms it replaces are those of that convolution.
